title: Compliance interlock & obligation tracker with gate checklist for SOC2/ISO onboarding
creator: Priya Singh
description: Goal: Create a single-pane obligation tracker and gate checklist that coordinates PM, Eng, Design, Security, and Legal workstreams for SOC2 and ISO onboarding. The tracker must: (1) enumerate obligations (controls, evidence artifacts, retention windows); (2) show owner, status, and ETA; (3) surface blocked items (dependencies on infra/eng work, third-party attestations); and (4) produce a pre-gate checklist artifact for audit readiness. This ticket scopes the first-phase productized tracker (UI + CSV import/export + webhook sync) and the cross-team rollout plan.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Tracker lists >95% of obligations for SOC2 + ISO baseline mapped to owners and existing evidence links; 2) Can import/export obligations as CSV with prescribed schema; 3) Webhook sync established to ingest GH PRs and Console dashboards for evidence status; 4) Pre-gate checklist PDF generated per customer with summary of open risks and mitigations; 5) Stakeholder sign-off (Security and Legal) captured in tracker for each gate.
milestones: Minimal viable tracker UI (read-only view + filters) — 2026-03-10
Webhook sync and CI signals ingestion — 2026-03-24
Exportable pre-gate checklist PDF and review loop — 2026-04-04
activity: 2026-01-25: Kickoff with Security, Legal, Eng reporting owners. Agreed single canonical obligations list instead of duplicated spreadsheets (Priya).
2026-02-03: Inventory pass completed by Security; ~87 obligations across SOC2/ISO identified. Missing retention windows for ~12 items (action: Eng infra contact).
2026-02-14: Schema draft reviewed — requested additional field 'evidence_hint' for where documentation typically lives (Confluence/Drive) — Luis to update.
2026-02-28: Design critique: emphasize filter by 'audit phase' and 'customer priority' — DES review scheduled.
2026-03-07: Engineering feasibility sync: webhook ingestion requires a small GH app and Console API mapping; ENG estimate 3 pts, blocked by ENG-41233 for single sign-on tokens.
decisions: Canonical source of truth will be the new tracker; spreadsheets will be migrated and archived after verification (Decision 2026-01-26).
Tracker will support CSV import/export first; API-first endpoints deferred to phase 2 to accelerate delivery (Decision 2026-02-14).
Pre-gate checklist will be generated as a customer-specific PDF containing a short summary, outstanding evidence, owners, and recommended mitigations (Decision 2026-03-01).
open_risks: Delay in ENG-41233 (SSO tokens for GH/Console) will block webhook ingestion and live evidence status updates.
Incomplete evidence retention metadata from Legal may cause inaccurate audit artifacts for ISO retention-specific controls.
High-priority customer audits (ad hoc) could require expedited extraction flows not covered by MVP export format.
next_steps: Luis: finalize CSV schema and push updated spec to Drive (due 2026-03-14).
Security: confirm retention windows for the 12 missing obligations and add evidence owners (due 2026-03-18).
Eng: land minimal webhook consumer + internal GH app skeleton (PR draft by 2026-03-20).
Design: provide read-only tracker mocks and filter UX by 2026-03-16.
